sections.description: The core bridge between Exacoat Manager ERP, WooCommerce orders, custom status, and fulfillment tracking.
sections.changelog:
### Version 0.0.42
- Added server-side courier filtering in get_orders REST handler across shipping order items and carrier metadata
- Synchronized pagination and total counts for filtered order queries
- Updated 4x6 shipping label button to display amber when unprinted and normal grey when printed
- Restricted shop manager role permissions to orders management only
